SHIONTHEBRUISER-DAMAGE_CAP.title: Damage Cap
SHIONTHEBRUISER-DAMAGE_CAP.description: Each hit of this Attack can only deal up to [blue]{DamageCap}[/blue] damage.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRITICAL_HIT.title: Critical
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRITICAL_HIT.description:
[gold]Critical Hits[/gold] deal [blue]50%[/blue] more damage.
Cards, Powers and relics can increase your [gold]Critical Hit[/gold] chance, rolled for each hit.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRITICAL_DRAW.title: Critical Draw
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRITICAL_DRAW.descriptio:
When you draw this card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], gain [blue]{CriticalDraw}%[/blue] [gold]Critical Hit[/gold] chance this turn.
[gold]Critical Draw[/gold] can grant at most [blue]50%[/blue] [gold]Critical Hit[/gold] chance per turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-PATCH_UP.title: Patch Up
SHIONTHEBRUISER-PATCH_UP.description:
Heal for {PatchUp:cond:>0?[blue]{PatchUp}[/blue] HP|the amount specified}.
This healing cannot put you above [blue]{PatchUpLimit}%[/blue] of your Max HP{PatchUpInCombat:cond:>0?.|, unless modified by other effects.}
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAM_BLAST_GAUGE.title: Team Blast
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAM_BLAST_GAUGE.descrip:
Players fill this gauge together by dealing damage, blocking damage and taking damage, or when any creature dies (less if it's [gold]Osty[/gold]).
Once full, players with a [gold]Team Blast[/gold] card add an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] copy of it into their [gold]Hand[/gold] at the start of each turn (only one per card). Each [gold]Team Blast[/gold] in any player's deck makes the gauge fill 20% faster.
Only one [gold]Team Blast[/gold] can be used per combat. The gauge carries over between combats, but empties at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold] and after a combat where a [gold]Team Blast[/gold] was used.{ChargeBonus:cond:>0?
Filling {ChargeBonus}% faster.|}{Locked:cond:>0?
[gold]Locked[/gold] for this combat.|}
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EMERALD_WHEEL.title: Chaos Emeralds
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EMERALD_WHEEL.descriptio: Add an [gold]Emerald Power[/gold] to your hand (each one once per fight), or turn your Rings' protection off and on.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EMERALD_WHEEL_USED.descr: Already used this fight. Defeating an enemy makes one used [gold]Emerald Power[/gold] available again.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EMERALD_WHEEL_MISSING.de: You don't have this Chaos Emerald.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EMERALD_WHEEL_TOGGLE.on:
Your Rings absorb the damage you take.
Select to turn it off.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EMERALD_WHEEL_TOGGLE.off:
Your Rings don't absorb damage.
Select to turn it back on.
